body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M\), \(x\in\mathcal X\), and \((s,t)\in\mathbb R^2\), \(F_x(s,t)=p_x\varphi_{f,x}(s+t)\varphi_1(s)\varphi_2(t)\) and \(G_x(s,t)=p_x\varphi_{q,x}(s+t)\varphi_1(s)\varphi_2(t)\); moreover \(\inf_{|u|\le\nu_*}|\varphi_j(u)|\ge1/2\) for \(j\in\{1,2\}\).
body.justification: The common nuisance factor makes the probability and marked channels comparable on one protected cube, while the moment bound derives protection rather than assuming it.
body.gap: Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy derive the unmarked factorization; the signed outcome-marked factorization and its joint use for a causal quotient are not part of their result.
body.consumer: The paired factorization is the input to the sharp inverse modulus and to every computable profile restriction.
